document.abstract: Cold mirror coatings have been incorporated into reflector lamps (or use in the home 8mm motion-picture projector. Light output shows little or no loss, whereas the total energy absorbed by the film has been reduced by 50% for some films. Methods for testing these lamps are shown. Problems of coating uniformity, visible light reflectance, infrared transmission, and color bias are discussed.
